messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: high error rate from auroraforge-prod (private VPC) egress to partner API — alerting on 502/timeout spikes, hitting NLB unhealthy checks :rotating_light:
oncall-elaine: on it. grabbing current runbook for vpc-egress. can someone paste SG + NLB recent changes?
netops-raj: I saw an automated policy apply to auroraforge-sg at 03:12 UTC that removed outbound rule to 198.51.100.0/24 (partner CIDR). rolling back now.
eng-sre-mike: backing up: symptoms are NLB health checks failing then backend pool marking unhealthy, customer app sees 5xx and timed out downstream calls. also seeing conntrack high on NAT instances.
oncall-elaine: customer impact?
julia-cs: AuroraForge reports degraded inference latencies for a subset of requests that hit partner reranking — major enterprise tenant SLA impacted. they opened an incident on their side too.
netops-raj: rollback applied to auroraforge-sg — re-added outbound 198.51.100.0/24:443 and allowed ephemeral ports. pinging partner health endpoint now.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: security-group-change detected by cloud-audit (change id sg-apply-778). linked runbook: #vpc-egress-troubleshoot
eng-sre-mike: conntrack still high on nat-aurora-01; new connections not draining. suspect long-lived TCP due to stalled upstream. scaling nat pool to relieve.
oncall-elaine: temp mitigation: 1) reopen SG (done) 2) scale NAT pool + reduce idle timeout on NAT 3) fail traffic to hosted fallback for affected customer routes. need permission to reroute?
product-omar: approve fallback to hosted for auroraforge-prod route while we stabilize. need ETA for rollback -> full recovery path.
netops-raj: NAT pool scaled + NAT idle-timeout set to 30s. NLB healthchecks started to show partial recovery (some nodes healthy).
customer-auroraforge-sysadmin: thanks, we still see ~20% requests failing. partner endpoint responds intermittently. can you share which IPs you opened?
oncall-elaine: opened 198.51.100.0/24 outbound to 443 and allowed ephemeral 1024-65535. also added targeted security-group rule for the NLB target-group.
julia-cs: notifying customer success escalation team and sending interim status to customer-facing channel.
eng-sre-mike: additional mitigation: add temporary routing rule to send auroraforge-prod inference traffic to dedicated-redwood-pool (isolated hosts) to avoid shared NAT pressure. starting traffic-shift 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks.
incident-bot: oncall-handoff: @oncall-elaine is handing to @eng-sre-mike for next 30m — look for conclusive green on NLB & partner.
netops-raj: partner reported a brief outage on their side correlating with our timeframe. they're continuing remediation; partner suggests connection reuse causing stall. we've enabled aggressive TCP keepalive on the NLB targets:

```
# enable keepalive on target service config
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time=60
```
eng-sre-mike: after keepalive + NAT scale + SG rollback, backend success rates climbed to ~96% on dedicated pool. still seeing a small window of 5xx during failover steps.
oncall-elaine: posting incident note for status page: 'AuroraForge private VPC experienced degraded egress to a partner API due to a security-group policy change plus partner-side connection handling; mitigations applied (SG rollback, NAT scaling, keepalive, targeted traffic shift). Customer routed to dedicated pool; monitoring.'
julia-cs: drafted customer message and ETA for full validation: 45m. sending now.
product-omar: request post-incident action items: 1) prevent automated SG removal for customer-managed groups 2) add alert for conntrack > 70% 3) test failover path monthly 4) cross-test partner connection reuse scenarios.
eng-sre-mike: logging runbook additions. I'll schedule a short sync with netops and customer success to validate steps and sign off.
customer-auroraforge-sysadmin: appreciate quick response. please include partner contact details in postmortem so we can coordinate on their side.
netops-raj: note: audit shows change was from an automated cleanup job targeting unused CIDR entries — adding an allowlist for enterprise VPCs.
incident-bot: incident-severity: sev-2 (partial customer outage) — timeline recorded.
oncall-elaine: handoff complete to @eng-sre-mike. if anything regresses ping page immediately. :thumbsup:
eng-sre-mike: monitoring 10m and then will transition to follow-up/PM. will attach logs and diffs to the postmortem draft.
julia-cs: thanks team — will coordinate customer update and include postmortem when ready. :white_check_mark:
